info.title: Web Scraper API - JavaScript Rendering, Proxy Rotation & CAPTCHA Solving
info.description: Executes a sequence of scraping instructions against a target URL and returns the extracted data. Two modes are available via the `jsEnabled` query parameter: `jsEnabled=true` renders the page in a real browser and supports `fill`, `click`, `wait`, iframe switching, image/audio CAPTCHA solving, and other interactive instructions, plus request-level `blockUrl` and `cookies`; `jsEnabled=false` fetches static HTML and supports `postForm`, `getForm`, `getPage`, and `extract`. Every mode's response is an `extractedData` object keyed by the field names used in your `extract` instructions --- each value is a string when its selector matched exactly one element, or an array of strings when it matched more than one; a selector that matches nothing is omitted from the response entirely. The `text` query parameter strips HTML tags from extracted values; under `jsEnabled=true`, single-element matches are always returned as plain text regardless of `text`, while multi-element matches keep tags unless `text=true` is set.

post.summary: Execute a sequence of web scraping instructions against a target URL
post.description: Runs form-filling, clicking, data-extraction, and CAPTCHA-solving instructions against a target URL and returns the extracted data. Behavior and available instructions depend on the jsEnabled query parameter.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Set to true to strip HTML tags from extracted values (plain text). Set to false to keep HTML tags. Default is false. Under jsEnabled=true, single-element matches are always plain text regardless of this flag.

parameters.name: jsEnabled
parameters.description: Set to true to render the page in a real browser for dynamic/JavaScript-driven pages (enables fill, click, wait, CAPTCHA-solving, and related instructions). Set to false to fetch static HTML only (enables postForm, getForm, getPage, extract). Default is false.

parameters.name: proxy
parameters.description: Use a proxy for the request. Pass true/false to toggle the default proxy pool, or a proxy URL string to use a specific proxy.

parameters.name: sslIgnore
parameters.description: Set to true to ignore SSL certificate errors on the target site. Only works when jsEnabled is true.

parameters.name: windowSize
parameters.description: Browser window size in the format 'width,height' (e.g. '1920,1080'). Only works when jsEnabled is true.

parameters.name: adBlock
parameters.description: Set to true to block ads on the target page. Only works when jsEnabled is true.

parameters.name: captcha
parameters.description: Set to true to allow CAPTCHA-solving instructions (generalImageCaptcha, fillImageCaptcha, resolveAudioCaptcha) in the request body. Only works when jsEnabled is true.

requestBody.description: The request body shape depends on the jsEnabled query parameter, not on any field inside the body itself. Pass jsEnabled=true for the interactive/browser instruction set (JsEnabledTrueBody: fill, click, wait, blockUrl, cookies, CAPTCHA solving, and more). Pass jsEnabled=false (or omit it) for the static-HTML instruction set (JsEnabledFalseBody: postForm, getForm, getPage, extract). instructions is an ordered array executed sequentially.

400.description: Bad Request — Missing/invalid parameters, malformed request body, unparseable selectors, or the target URL could not be fetched

value.message: Invalid or malformed JSON. Please check your request body format and ensure it's valid JSON.
Check the Css Selectors or Xpath, Some of them are wrong

targetUnreachable.summary: Target URL could not be reached (DNS/connection failure)

targetNonOkStatus.summary: Target URL returned a non-200 HTTP response

404.description: Not Found — Wrong HTTP method or path used against this endpoint

wrongMethodOrPath.summary: Endpoint called with a non-POST method

value.message: The requested resource could not be found. Please verify the URL and try again.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

JsEnabledTrueBody.description: Request body for jsEnabled=true: renders the page in a real browser and supports interactive instructions.

blockUrl.description: List of script or URL patterns to block during network requests.

cookies.description: List of cookies to be set in the browser session.

instructions.description: An ordered list of step-by-step scraping instructions to be executed in the browser. Each item is one Instruction object, with exactly one action field set.

Instruction.description: A single browser scraping step. Exactly one of these action fields is set per instruction; every other field is absent.

fill.description: Fill action: fills an input field with a value using a CSS or XPath selector.

click.description: Click action: CSS selector or XPath identifying the element to click.

clickIfExist.description: Click if exists action: CSS selector or XPath identifying the element to click, only if it appears on the page within a short timeout.

enter.description: Enter key action: CSS selector or XPath identifying the element to send an Enter keystroke to.

newTab.description: New tab action: set to true to switch focus to a newly opened browser tab.

moveToRelativeTab.description: Move to relative tab action: relative tab index to move to (e.g. 1 for the next tab, -1 for the previous tab).

wait.description: Wait action: pauses execution for this many milliseconds.

waitFor.description: Wait for element action: CSS selector or XPath identifying the element to wait for before continuing.

select.description: Select dropdown action: selects an option from a dropdown element by selector and matching value.

jsExe.description: Execute JavaScript action: JavaScript code to execute inside the page context.

conditionalCheck.description: Conditional check action: list of conditional steps, each supporting if-<method> and else-<method> keys with conditions, executed based on element state.

items.description: A single conditional step, supporting if-<method> and else-<method> keys with conditions.

clickButtonByValue.description: Click button by value action: clicks a button that matches a specific text or value attribute.

generalImageCaptcha.description: Image captcha solver action: instructions for solving image-based captchas using a selected model.

blockElement.description: Block element action: list of CSS selectors or XPaths for elements to block or hide on the page.

extract.description: Extract data action: defines what data to extract and how, keyed by whatever field names you choose.

fillImageCaptcha.description: Fill image captcha action: captures and fills image-based captcha values automatically.

switchToIframe.description: Switch to iframe action: switches the browser context into an iframe identified by name or ID.

switchToParentFrame.description: Switch to parent frame action: returns the browser context from an iframe back to its parent frame.

resolveAudioCaptcha.description: Resolve audio captcha action: solves audio-based captcha challenges and fills the resolved text into the target field.

screenshot.description: Screenshot action: captures a screenshot of the current page state. Can be a boolean-like value or a selector.

saveimage.description: Save image action: saves an image from the page by CSS selector or element ID.

Cookie.description: A single cookie to set in the browser session before running instructions.

PlaceValue.description: A selector/value pair used by fill, select, and clickButtonByValue instructions.

place.description: CSS or XPath selector identifying the target element.

value.description: Value to fill, select, or match against.

ImageCaptchaInstruction.description: Instructions for locating and solving a single image CAPTCHA challenge.

imagePath.description: Selector for the CAPTCHA image element.

textField.description: Selector for the field where the CAPTCHA text is entered.

imageUpdatePath.description: Selector to refresh or update the CAPTCHA image.

captchaFailedPath.description: Selector indicating a CAPTCHA failure so the solver can retry.

AudioCaptchaInstruction.description: Selectors for locating and solving a single audio CAPTCHA challenge.

audioPath.description: Selector for the audio CAPTCHA element.

textField.description: Selector for the field where the resolved audio CAPTCHA text is entered.

ExtractInstruction.description: Maps arbitrary output field names to CSS or XPath selectors. Each key becomes a field in the response's extractedData object.

additionalProperties.title: SelectorForField
additionalProperties.description: CSS selector or XPath identifying the element(s) to extract for this output field. Example: 'h1' or '/html/body/div/div[2]'.

JsEnabledFalseBody.description: Request body for jsEnabled=false (or omitted): fetches static HTML only, no browser rendering.

instructions.description: A list of sequential instructions to execute against the static HTML response. Each item is one StaticInstruction object, with exactly one action field set.

StaticInstruction.description: A single static-HTML scraping step. Exactly one of these action fields is set per instruction; every other field is absent.

postForm.description: POST form action: submits a form using the POST method. Provide the form's XPath/CSS selector and input values.

getForm.description: GET form action: submits a form using the GET method. Provide the form's XPath/CSS selector and input values.

extract.description: Extract data action: defines what data to extract and how, keyed by whatever field names you choose.

getPage.description: Get page action: retrieves the full page content. Optionally provide a URL or selector to target a specific page.

FormSubmission.description: Form selector and field values to submit via postForm or getForm.

selector.description: CSS or XPath selector identifying the form element.

data.description: Form field name/value pairs to submit.

additionalProperties.title: FormFieldValue
additionalProperties.description: Value to submit for this form field.

ScrapingResponse.description: Result of running the scraping instructions against the target URL.

extractedData.description: Container keyed by the field names used in your extract instructions. A field is present only if its selector matched at least one element on the page.

ExtractedField.title: ExtractedField
ExtractedField.description: The value scraped for one field of an extract instruction. A string when the selector matched exactly one element (content depends on the text query parameter and, under jsEnabled=true, is always plain text). An array of strings, in document order, when the selector matched more than one element (each entry keeps HTML tags unless text=true is set). A field whose selector matched nothing is omitted from extractedData entirely rather than appearing as an empty value.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response returned when a request fails.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.
